description: This file defines a protocol and extension for location services using CoreLocation, including methods for configuring location managers, requesting authorization status, and asynchronously requesting the current location.

methods.name: configureLocationManager
methods.description: Configures the CLLocationManager by setting delegate and desired accuracy.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current authorization status of CLLocationManager.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Retrieves the accuracy authorization from the location manager.

methods.name: requestLocationOnce
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a single location update and returns it.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Provides compatibility for varying iOS and macOS versions to obtain location accuracy authorization.

methods.name: requestLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously requests location update, setting a continuation for the result.
